zoe: FYI we've got RedWave booked for a focused whitebox against staging + infra next week. Need to lock RBAC window, KMS access (and HSM question), evidence ingestion format, PII handling, and a retest policy. loop in @rahul and @nisha
rahul: Prefer a 3hr, staging-only window. Ephemeral SSO role only. No CI tokens, no prod. Add a short Conduct Rules doc (no data exfil, no social engineering).
kevin: Plan: create session role `pt:redwave:{id}` with conditions: aws:SourceIp (vendor IPs), aws:RequestedDurationSeconds <= 10800. Limit actions to read/list/describe for staging resources. For KMS, offer a CMK with GenerateDataKey + Decrypt. If customer/regulatory needs HSM, we can swap to HSM-backed CMK but need 48h lead time.
nisha: Audit requirements: enable CloudTrail management + S3 data events for ingest prefix, forward to SIEM, tag events with `pt_id` and `engagement`. Retention 395 days. Also capture presign service logs.
zoe: Evidence ingest: presigned single-part PUTs into `s3://pt-evidence/redwave/{id}/incoming/`. Require headers: `x-amz-meta-sha256` and `x-amz-meta-pt_id`. Filename pattern `redwave-{id}/{type}/{file}`. No multipart. Max single file 350MB.
rahul: We'll require a manifest JSON per upload if it's an archive (.tar.gz) listing member files and their sha256s. Example manifest fields: {"pt_id":"...","files":[{"name":"...","size":123,"sha256":"..."}],"uploader":"redwave"}
kevin: shareable KMS example for vendor: 
```
{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:Decrypt"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/redwave-pt-key"}
```
ingest-bot: [INFO] Presign service constraints: single-part PUT only, max 350MB, require x-amz-meta-sha256 and x-amz-meta-pt_id. Emit structured JSON logs to /pt-presign: {"svc":"presign","pt_id":"<id>","uploader":"vendor","file":"<name>","result":"success|fail","sha256":"<hex>"}.
nisha: PII handling: ingestion pipeline must run a lightweight scrub for PII (emails, SSNs, CCNs). If obvious PII found, redact or flag and require manual review before indexing in vuln-tracker. Add an automated tag `pii:found` on flagged objects.
zoe: Intake: vendor may POST findings to our webhook (preferred) which creates a `PT Intake` card on vuln-tracker. Backup: upload findings.json to ingest prefix. SLA: ack within 24h, triage note within 48h, remediation ETA: 3 business days for criticals, 7 for high/non-critical.
kevin: Retest policy: vendor can request one retest within 10 business days after we mark fixes deployed. Offer two candidate windows (overnight preferred): 01:00-04:00 PT or 05:00-08:00 PT. Oncall to confirm staffing. Post-window: immediate rotation of any KMS keys used and revoke ephemeral sessions.
rahul: operational notes: presign service should enforce metadata `pt_id` and checksum before returning success to vendor. Also produce a checksum-validation event to the audit stream when lambda verifies and moves to `locked/`.
zoe: Action owners (due EOD):
- kevin: create session role + session policy JSON + KMS policy (shareable)
- rahul: implement presign constraints + checksum validator + manifest validator + ObjectLock move
- nisha: enable CloudTrail/S3 data events + SIEM forwarding + retention tags and compliance note on PII handling
- zoe: send vendor onboarding email with presign example and Conduct Rules doc
pd-bot: [BOT] PagerDuty stub PD-PT-REDWAVE created for test window
kevin: ack
rahul: ack
nisha: ack
zoe: sending handshake now -> https://docs.internal.redwood/pt-redwave-onboard (includes manifest schema, curl examples, and Conduct Rules). Reopen thread if vendor asks for HSM or cross-cloud SAS. Thanks all!
